The '''Odominic''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
In [[4225 BBY]], the Odominic began sell black-market arms to the various criminal elements of Kaikielius, causing many cities to devolve into police-on-gang warfare. The [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] manipulated the Odominic into supplying both sides in the conflict and [[Derrica Praji]] discovered some [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]] that recorded their agreement. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent troops to Kaikielius to restore order and the Odominic were driven from the planet.
